scope_statement: The 407 target records are the 70 baseline-2008 captures, 12 after-anchor-2008 supplements including ss30, and 325 pre-2008 supplement targets. This audit covers the frozen image scope, not full-site restoration.

prior16_changed_gate.note: 15 valid JPEGs passed the legacy LF gate; the 16th target was recovered by the separate root id_ retry map.

transport_eleven.body_accounting_note: The runner conservatively sums wire and decoded counters. With identity/no compression they are the same physical response bytes, so 160804 is accounting total, not unique network bytes; unique observed response bytes are 80402.

root_id_retry.note: Historical im_ HTTP 404 and the earlier id_ digest rejection remain evidence; the changed LF gate plus one id_ retry produced a valid JPEG. The saved body is unmodified.

limitations: HTTP/HTTPS aliases are matched by the frozen comparison key; path and query case are preserved.

CDX digest comparison uses the selected digest recorded by the frozen plan. For the 27 LF-gated entities, raw payload digest and selected framed digest remain separate fields; no LF is added to saved image bytes.
The 407 count is the frozen target scope and does not claim all official site resources were restored.
